create.name: Tim Kelley
create.bio:
Tim Kelley is an American teacher and consultant who founded the True Purpose Institute, a training school and community for people who feel called to make a difference in the world. Before this work he studied mathematics at MIT and served as a naval officer, including command of an amphibious assault craft unit, later retiring from the Naval Reserve. His central method helps people make direct contact with what he calls a trusted source of inner wisdom and, through it, draw out a detailed picture of their life purpose rather than one vague statement. He set the method out in his book True Purpose, since revised and expanded, and he has co-written three further books.

Much of his work today is with leaders and organisations: he helps executives and teams find a higher purpose for the groups they lead, advises on non-hierarchical ways of organising, and has worked with businesses and public figures in several countries. Through the institute he trains coaches, therapists, ministers and consultants to use his purpose process with individuals and with groups, co-leading the organisational consultant training, and he speaks at the institute's free monthly gathering for change agents. His wider teaching also draws on parts work and on the shift from a life run by old hurts to one led by purpose.

courses.title: True Purpose Organizational Consultant Training and Certification
courses.description: An advanced year-long training, co-led by him, for consultants who want to help teams and organisations find their collective higher purpose through inner guidance. Completing the True Purpose coach training is a prerequisite, and admission is by application.
courses.price: $4995 USD (with the required coach certification fast-track, $9990 USD; monthly payment plans offered)

courses.title: True Purpose Coach Training
courses.description: A twelve-week Zoom training in his purpose-coaching method for experienced coaches, therapists and ministers, led by senior institute teachers with him as guest teacher. The 2026 cohort is closed; private-format trainings are arranged on request.

courses.title: True Purpose Guided Meditations
courses.description: A set of three downloadable audios from the institute for connecting with inner guidance when exploring purpose: a guided meditation, a quieter deepening version and the accompanying music on its own.

free_resources.title: Introduction to Higher Purpose Coaching eCourse
free_resources.description: A free short course delivered by email in weekly parts, introducing the True Purpose approach for coaches and other practitioners who want to help clients find their life purpose.

free_resources.title: The Gathering for Change Agents
free_resources.description: A free online circle held on the first Wednesday of each month since 2012, with a guest speaker and conversation for people working to create a better world. He is among the regular presenters.
